# tfcensus drift

drift runs a plan in every Terragrunt unit and reports the resources that changed outside
terraform, attribute by attribute. It runs

```text
terragrunt run --all [--filter ...] --tf-path <bin> --json-out-dir <tmp> --report-file <tmp>/report.json
  --report-format json --log-format json -- plan -refresh-only -lock=false -detailed-exitcode
```

in each repo, with TG\_TF\_PATH set, and reads every unit's tfplan.json and the run report. Plain
Terraform root modules are skipped. With --mode full, the plan isn't refresh-only, and drift tells
the drift the plan reverts (the code disagrees) from the drift it keeps.

--from-json-out-dir reads plans an earlier terragrunt run wrote, without running anything. Pass the
same run's --report-file, so units that failed before writing a plan are reported.

Identical changes in several units become one group (--collapse shape compares type, action and
attribute paths; strict also compares values; none keeps one group per change). Noise rules under
drift.noise hide attribute changes or whole changes; the presets aws-tags-all and computed-hashes
hide tags\_all updates and computed hashes. A rule past its expires date stops hiding drift and
drift warns. drift.never\_hide (default delete and replace) lists actions no rule can hide.

drift prints attribute paths, never values. --show-attributes adds before and after values;
sensitive values show as (sensitive) and unknown ones as (known after apply).

The exit code is 3 when a --fail-on gate counts at least --min-count: drift counts drifted
resources, drift:reverts the ones the plan reverts (--mode full only), errors the failed units. It
is 1 when a unit or a repo failed and no gate matched, and 0 otherwise. terraform's
\-detailed-exitcode (2 for changes) is read internally and never returned.

## Usage

```sh
tfcensus drift [paths...] [flags]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `paths` | no | yes |

## Flags

| Flag | Description | Type | Default | Values | Config key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--collapse` | group identical changes across units: shape, strict or none (config drift.collapse) | string | `shape` | `shape`: same type, action and attribute paths<br>`strict`: shape, and the same before and after values<br>`none`: one group per change | [`drift.collapse`](/reference/config#drift-collapse) |  |
| `--fail-on` | exit 3 when these gates match: drift, drift:reverts or errors | list, repeatable |  | `drift`: any unit drifted<br>`drift:reverts`: a full plan would revert drift<br>`errors`: a unit failed |  |  |
| `--filter` | terragrunt filter expression, passed to terragrunt find unchanged (repeatable) | string, repeatable |  |  |  | not with `--from-json-out-dir` |
| `--from-json-out-dir` | read the plans of an earlier terragrunt run --json-out-dir instead of running terragrunt | string |  |  |  | not with `--filter`; not with `--generate-stacks` |
| `--generate-stacks` | run terragrunt stack generate first, so units in stacks are listed (config discovery.generate\_stacks) | bool |  |  | [`discovery.generate_stacks`](/reference/config#discovery-generate-stacks) | not with `--from-json-out-dir` |
| `--md-max-chars` | cut Markdown output to this many characters at a row or section boundary; 0 means no limit | int | `60000` |  |  |  |
| `--min-count` | count a --fail-on gate needs before it exits 3 | int | `1` |  |  |  |
| `--mode` | plan mode: refresh-only or full; full also tells reverted drift from kept drift (config drift.mode) | string | `refresh-only` | `refresh-only`: plan -refresh-only: drift only<br>`full`: plan: drift, and whether the plan reverts it | [`drift.mode`](/reference/config#drift-mode) |  |
| `--out` | also write the report to a file as format=path (repeatable); format is one of plain, md, json, sarif or github | string, repeatable |  | `plain`: table without color<br>`md`: Markdown<br>`json`: JSON envelope for scripts<br>`sarif`: SARIF 2.1.0 for code scanning<br>`github`: GitHub Actions annotations |  |  |
| `--render` | when to use terragrunt render: auto, always or never (config discovery.render) | string | `auto` | `auto`: parse terragrunt.hcl, render the units it can't resolve<br>`always`: run terragrunt render for every unit<br>`never`: never run terragrunt render | [`discovery.render`](/reference/config#discovery-render) |  |
| `--report-file` | the JSON --report-file of that run | string |  |  |  |  |
| `--show-attributes` | show before and after values; sensitive and unknown values stay masked | bool |  |  |  |  |

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Output formats

`--format` accepts `tty`, `plain`, `md`, `json`, `sarif`, `github`. Without it, the format is `tty` when stdout is a terminal and `plain` otherwise. Formats are described on the [global flags](/cli/global-flags) page.

## Fail-on values

`--fail-on` makes the command exit 3 when the report has a match:

| Value | Matches |
|---|---|
| `drift` | any unit drifted |
| `drift:reverts` | a full plan would revert drift |
| `errors` | a unit failed |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The command finished. With --fail-on, nothing matched. |
| 1 | The command failed: a read, a write, a child process or a check failed. |
| 2 | Wrong usage: an unknown command or flag, a bad value or argument, an invalid config file, or a prompt with no terminal. |
| 3 | A --fail-on gate matched. The report is still written. |
| 130 | Interrupted by Ctrl-C (SIGINT) or a cancelled context. |

All codes are listed on the [exit codes](/reference/exit-codes) page.

## Examples

```sh
tfcensus drift ~/src/infra/acme-live --filter './live/prod/**' --fail-on drift
tfcensus drift --mode full --fail-on drift:reverts --format md > drift.md
tfcensus drift --from-json-out-dir out --report-file out/report.json --format github \
  --out sarif=drift.sarif --out md=drift.md --fail-on drift
```
